|notes=The 2006 slip restates the immediate response to verifying the opponent’s Reserve Deck and spells the searched term ‘podracer.’ The [[A Tremor In The Force (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Original)|original-edition slip]] survives in the consolidated PDF made in February 2003. The sheet gives 20 September 2002 as the set’s tournament-legality date, and the complete set was available by 21 September. The [[A Tremor In The Force (V) (Virtual Set 3: Revolution) (Remastered 2006)|2006 publication]] gives its text as of 4 December 2006.
